answer: Make the first reward the most expensive one to reach. Designated credit assessor registration with credit assessors standing does that, because a registration assessors keep after file audits. The nectar for a single honest agent is a short check; for a farm it is a renewal audit every year per name, so the farm pays the entry price again and again just to stay alive repeated on every name. Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the thread per clone stays flat while the bill climbs, and the onyx is the point where cloning stops paying.
